selection_basis: Complete stable six-scene official online canaries, grouped by current-frame versus temporal input; choose the lowest Q within each group before frozen runs and before DEV access.
frozen_policy: Disable only stage1_position_runtime.update_enabled. Keep B attitude RBF, PCF, FEATURE gamma=12, kappa=1, and all other controller settings unchanged.
dev_order_policy: Lock the DEV24 order only after both frozen six-scene runs finish, using the lowest complete stable online-or-frozen six-scene Q per model configuration. First candidate is the lower-Q configuration; second is the other configuration.
